data.description: Invest in Azizi Milan Heights – Modern Homes with Premium Finishes
data.display_address: Azizi Milan Heights, City of Arabia, Dubai
data.long_description:
Azizi Milan Heights is a residential development by Azizi Developments, part of the large-scale Azizi Milan project, located in the City of Arabia district. The project combines modern architecture with elegant design.

It consists of eight towers. All buildings feature three basement levels, a ground floor, five podium floors, and two technical floors. Towers A, B, E, and F comprise 37 residential floors and a roof, while towers C, D, G, and H have 40 residential floors and a roof. The buildings showcase a sleek design with clean lines, surrounded by green areas and offering direct access to the lagoon that creates a serene resort atmosphere. The project offers studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments with modern interiors emphasizing light, comfort, and quality materials.

Residents can enjoy six infinity pools, five children’s pools, a fitness center, a cinema, play areas, saunas, jacuzzis, steam rooms, barbecue areas, jogging and cycling tracks, parking, and 24-hour security.

The complex has easy access to key city destinations: IMG Worlds of Adventure — 2 min, Global Village — 15 min, The Palm Jumeirah — 15 min, Expo City Dubai — 19 min, Business Bay and Dubai Mall — 20 min, Dubai International Airport — 25 min.
